examples.note: Christmas Island — the dedicated 9164 exchange within Australia's 08 area code

notes: Christmas Island is an Australian external territory inside the +61 plan; it has no country code of its own.
It used +672 until October 1994, when it migrated to +61 and eventually settled on the 08 9164 range.
Administered by ACMA under the Australian Telecommunications Numbering Plan.
sources: ACMA — Australian Communications and Media Authority: https://www.acma.gov.au/numbering
